name: @appkit/ui
description: Shared React UI components for web, desktop, and mobile apps

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm build:js && pnpm build:types
scripts.build:js: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --watch --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime
